name: GOV minter: MinterConfigured
description: Circle FiatToken v2.x (native USDC/EURC): MinterConfigured(address,uint256) emitted by a contract tagged mf-privileged. Default severity critical. The privChangeGuard Web3 Action decodes the change, classifies the new holder (EOA, EIP-7702, Safe, timelock) and checks for prior notice.
